patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\"\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003EA 50 year old male patient construction worker by occupation came with complaints of\u0026nbsp;\u003Cdiv\u003ELoss of appetite since 25 days\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptommatic 2 years back when he went to the hospital with complaints of loss of appetite and was diagnosed to have renal failure and hypertension.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient had dialysis beginning from 2019 till 2020 in outside hospital\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen in 2021 he came to our hospital and had 2-3 dailysis after which dialysis was stopped and he was on conservative management and had regular follow ups.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe came with complaints of loss of appetite since 25 days and pain in bilateral loin region since 25 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of decreased urine output, pedal edema, shortness of breath, chest pain, palpatations, cough.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of usage of NSAID's (3-4\/day) because of bilateral knee joint pains, pricking type which was aggravated with work and relieved by taking medication.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHypertensive since 2 years on medication Tab. Amlong 2.5mg and Tab. Arkamin100mg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENon diabetic\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo alcohol abuse\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENon smoker\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe takes mixed diet, loss of appetite, bowel and bladder movements are regular.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of tuberculosis, asthma, epilepsy.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn examination:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVitals:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBP-140\/90 mm hg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPR- 86 bpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETemp- afebrile\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERR- 20 cpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESpo2- 98% on room air\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPallor- present\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo signs of icterus, cyanosis, clubbing, lymphaenopathy, edema\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECVS: S1 S2 +, no murmurs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERS: BAE+, NVBS,no added sounds\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECNS: NAD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EP\/A: distended, soft, non tender, BS+\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
